prompt_prefix: Image 1 is the identity reference. Image 2 is a wireframe orientation guide, not a style reference. Make one photograph of the exact person from image 1 with the HEAD ORIENTATION shown in image 2. Keep the original hair, clothes, background, lighting and camera framing. Keep the shoulders stationary, mouth closed and expression neutral. Change the head pose only. Output the photograph only.

yaw-left.prompt: Follow the arrow in image 2: the nose points toward the LEFT edge of the picture. Use a visible but small 12-degree head turn. Keep both eyes visible. Do not copy the frontal pose from image 1.

yaw-right.prompt: Follow the arrow in image 2: the nose points toward the RIGHT edge of the picture. Use a visible but small 12-degree head turn. Keep both eyes visible. Do not copy the frontal pose from image 1.

pitch-up.prompt: Raise the chin slightly and tilt the head UPWARD about 6 degrees around the neck, keeping yaw and roll unchanged. The underside of the chin becomes slightly more visible. Do not lift or translate the whole head in the frame.

pitch-down.prompt: Lower the chin slightly and tilt the head DOWNWARD about 6 degrees around the neck, keeping yaw and roll unchanged. The top of the head becomes slightly more visible. Do not lower or translate the whole head in the frame.

identity_acceptance: Automatic geometry/framing checks do not establish likeness. Preserve every rejected result; identity and material continuity still require visual review.
request_policy: No automatic retries or new allowance. Any revised acquisition configuration must have its own explicit authorization and immutable budget binding.
